title: Reveal Cards In Increasing Order
statement:
Given a deck of distinct integers, arrange it so that repeatedly revealing the top card and then moving the next top card to the bottom reveals the cards in increasing order. Return the required deck order.

## Examples

```text
Input: deck = [17, 13, 11, 2, 3, 5, 7]
Output: [2, 13, 3, 11, 5, 17, 7]
```

```text
Input: deck = [1, 1000]
Output: [1, 1000]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= deck.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= deck[i] <= 10^6`
- All values in `deck` are distinct.
